about: Built by tools/build_met_map.py from The Met’s own indoor map (maps.metmuseum.org, made by Living Map): every floor of The Met Fifth Avenue with its numbered galleries, corridors, restrooms, elevators, stairs, cafés, stores, coat checks, information and ticket desks, water fountains and entrances where The Met puts them. Turned like The Met’s printed map, with Fifth Avenue at the bottom. Openings between rooms come from the map’s door lines; a few are inferred where two rooms meet with no wall.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, interactive map (maps.metmuseum.org, Living Map), November 2026
units: 2 units per meter; Fifth Avenue is at the bottom
